about.title: About me
about.summary: Senior Software Engineer with {expYears}+ years of product in production. Since March 2024 I own delivery at Heinsohn for health platforms on AWS (CareTree, Dala) and donations on GCP (Islamic Relief Canada), with Laravel, Go and React. I prioritize whatever stops a person or a company from working. When a requirement arrives incomplete, I write the plan and close the cause, not only the symptom. University teaching in parallel, 2 to 4 hours a week. English C2. I live in Medellín.
about.role: Senior Software Engineer at Heinsohn · University professor
about.motto: Deliver more than was asked, and say it clearly.
about.bio: At Heinsohn I moved from executing a defined scope to covering the team when the lead was away. I have been senior since March 2024. Two of us sustain CareTree and Dala, after an inherited security incident whose findings I owned. At Islamic Relief Canada the team is four people, plus the client's IT group. I classify every request as urgent, important or an improvement: urgent is whatever stops a person or a company from operating; important is what the client or the business says should work differently; an improvement request sits at medium or low priority depending on how many clients ask for it and the effect on the platform. When support cannot reproduce a CareTree or Dala case, I join the English session with the client, identify the cause and close it.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.intro: Internal promotion from junior to senior in March 2024. I joined on CareTree only. The product was sold twice and ended up at Dala, which until then was a competitor. I am now also accountable for Dala and Islamic Relief Canada. Every request is classified as urgent, important or an improvement, depending on whether it stops operations, the business requires different behavior, or it is an improvement request.

roles.summary: CareTree and Dala, on a team of two. Islamic Relief Canada, with four people plus the client's IT. Requirements rarely arrive closed: I slice them, prioritize them and leave them ready to ship.
responsibilities: On CareTree the team was seven people, and I covered for the lead during absences. Two of us remain from that original team. CareTree once served about 1,000 companies; today it operates with about 300, each with its own set of users. After an inherited security incident I owned the findings and completed a cybersecurity specialization.

I assessed CareTree and prioritized server and code vulnerabilities from critical to minor. The team fixed them. During an active attack, starting from traffic alerts a teammate received, I read the application server logs, reproduced the cause and we closed the exposure in 30 minutes. I implemented an active file scanner on AWS with ClamAV, with HIPAA compliance as the bar.

CareTree to Dala migration. The assignment was to move the data. I defined the plan and the implementation: AWS Glue jobs from the CareTree database to S3, Snowflake as the source of truth with a medallion architecture, schemas, pipes, triggers and endpoints so Dala can consume the data. I reserved full days per product and switched fronts only when something stopped people or the company from working. I tuned the jobs to shorten extraction time.

Islamic Relief Canada: mobile and web applications on GCP, with a short deadline and incomplete requirements, aimed at efficiency, speed and reuse. Heinsohn's project manager for Manizales, Pereira, Armenia, Cali and part of Bogotá asked me to support delivery management, together with the team. I organized prioritized tickets, published a working version for store review and coordinated store listings and infrastructure with the client's IT while adjustments continued. The team: two engineers, one data person and one artificial intelligence person.

On CareTree I design and prototype interfaces with the client before building them. When support cannot reproduce an incident on CareTree or Dala, I join the English session, clarify the case, find the cause and close it.
I established the delivery path: CI/CD from scratch, infrastructure with Terraform and feature branching, so each change reaches production with a bounded scope.

roles.summary: I moved from execution to requirements gathering. After the acquisition, CareTree moved to Dala and I started working with their IT team.
responsibilities: I gathered requirements with stakeholders and turned them into technical tasks.
On CareTree I delivered higher-complexity Laravel features, with autonomy over the solution design.
On Dala I took early, bounded work on APIs, React interfaces and the AWS architecture, in coordination with their IT team.
I reviewed code and took part in technical decisions shared across both products.

roles.summary: Execution of an already defined scope on CareTree, with emphasis on delivery quality.
responsibilities: I implemented CareTree tickets with scope and criteria defined by the team.
I built PHP/Laravel features, web and mobile, as assigned.
I focused on code, tests and delivery, without leading discovery, architecture or infrastructure.

experience.title: University Professor
experience.intro: Teaching in parallel with Heinsohn: 2 to 4 hours a week, one course a month and two at most.
bullets: Web services, operating systems, object-oriented programming, web programming, software design and analysis, databases, application security and emerging technologies.

experience.title: Junior Developer
experience.intro: QVO acquired the Business Solutions team. The five developers moved on to deliver projects for both companies. QVO's product is a management system for private security companies in Colombia: the operation lived in Excel, and the system centralized guards, escorts, canines, CCTV, quotes, commercial management, finance, dashboards and suppliers.
bullets: Full cycle in Laravel and MySQL: requirements, interface prototypes with the client, build, deployment, training and support.
Some users resisted the change. With sustained support they adopted the system and left the spreadsheets.

experience.title: Junior Developer

experience.title: Junior Developer

bullets: The CRM centralized legal documents, certificates, clients and venues.
I designed and prototyped the interfaces with the client before building them.

posts.intro: A technical article on how to identify and close attack surfaces in the cloud.
